replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
This will be a semi-tbh, so I'm not going to go hard, but I sure won't sugarcoat it.

Salt happens and it's fine to be salty, but showing it and being toxic isn't really acceptable. This is a warning, starting shit with people gets you nowhere quick and is a pretty easy way to get hated just as hastily, especially in a small, close-knit community such as Avicus'. Going around accusing people in chat does nothing but make you look bad and talking big when you win puts huge targets on your backs. I'll give you my honest opinion, from what i heard and saw, there is a lot you're doing wrong in terms of building relationships within the server as a team and quite frankly, the way some of your players have been acting towards certain community members is disgusting and rather dissapointing. Keep the salt and accusations within the team and you will be fine. I've played on and with teams that accuse a ton on ts, mumble, over Skype, but because it isn't in the open they aren't cosidered toxic. 

Gl
